title: Brazil Senior Condition Intelligence (Ci & Pm)
description:
Company DescriptionDingo Software is the global leader in predictive maintenance software for the mining industry, serving some of the world’s largest mining companies. We are best known for Driving efficiency, longevity and reliability for machines that matter. With 30+ years of asset health data, we're scaling rapidly under Riverside Company ownership to capture significant market opportunities.Following recent investment from The Riverside Company, Dingo is executing an ambitious growth strategy. We're building world-class commercial capabilities to support this growth journey.Role DescriptionAs a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime.In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within then Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo’s advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage client to identify risks before they escalate, ensuring consistently measurable results.With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo’s reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence.Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality.Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life.Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics.Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities.Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality.Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records.Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes.Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences.Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management.QualificationsExperience – Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments;
OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands-on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable.Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes.Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies.Technical Proficiency – Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions.Linguistic Proficiency – Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders.Communication & Leadership – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead interactions with both internal teams and external customers, building trust and alignment.

documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.

prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions. Credit Analysis & Risk Management: - Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history;
recommends credit limits and payment terms.
- Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk;
flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.
- Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies. Reporting & Analysis: - Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.
- Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.

- Based anywherein Brazil - Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish - Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus. our goal is to assemblea diverse team that will help us be leaders in our market. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. title: Analista De Marca E Conteúdo | Brand & Content Analyst
description: About Downtown Engineers Downtown Engineers (DWT ENG) is a New York-based MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) engineering firm trusted by architecture offices, developers and national brands. Our work spans from franchise rollouts for brands like McDonald's, Domino's and Dunkin' to hospitality projects with Hilton and Hyatt, healthcare and residential buildings across the United States, with a strong focus on New York City. We're a remote-first team of 20+ people across different countries, with 300+ projects delivered across 16+ sectors. Our culture is grounded in trust, transparency and autonomy and that's how we communicate too. About the Opportunity We're looking for a hands-on Brand & Content Analyst to help us build and sustain our authority in the market. This role sits at the intersection of brand, education and demand generation, creating content that builds trust with architects and developers before the first conversation ever happens. The ideal candidate is content-obsessed with a strong brand lens, someone who takes one idea and immediately sees multiple formats, narratives and distribution paths. Beyond producing content, you'll ensure that everything Downtown puts out communicates the brand clearly and consistently. You'll work closely with leadership, transforming technical knowledge into high-quality content, while reviewing and strengthening how the brand shows up across every touchpoint. Compensation & Structure Full-time contractor (remote) Fixed monthly compensation Please include your compensation expectation in BRL (R$) in your application What you’ll do 1.Content & channels Produce and distribute content across priority channels (LinkedIn, email, blog and future channels) Write copy, adapt templates, collaborate on visuals and test new formats Coordinate editorial calendar, approvals and publishing 2.Brand consistency & messaging Review and propose copy for the website, social media pages, presentations, events, campaigns and sales materials, ensuring brand clarity and tone across all touchpoints Research best practices and propose improvements to how Downtown communicates across channels Be the first line of quality control on how the brand shows up externally 3.Demand generation & sales enablement Create rich content (case studies, guides, studies, infographics) to educate architects and drive inbound demand Support sales with enablement materials and educational assets Help build Downtown's educational and thought leadership initiatives 4.Optimization & performance Ensure content is evergreen, performance-driven and SEO-friendly Track results, test improvements and iterate Requirements Must-haves Fluent English (written and spoken). Day-to-day communication is mostly in Portuguese as the Marketing team is entirely Brazilian. However, all official written communication and some of our meetings are conducted fully in English Strong writing and content creation skills Hands-on execution mindset with high autonomy, curiosity and ownership Ability to think in formats, distribution and repurposing and not just write and post Comfortable working with multiple channels and priorities without losing consistency Experience with content marketing or B2B communication Strong sense of brand consistency: you notice when messaging, tone or visuals feel off, you act on it. And you also proactively propose improvements Nice-to-haves Experience with SEO, content optimization or marketing automation tools Experience in technical, engineering or architecture-related industries Selection Process Apply to the opportunity, submitting the form with your CV and English experience Screening: English and communication assessment (video) Technical challenge Interviews with leadership Offer Why join Downtown? Role with direct business impact Work with top architects and U.S. brands Fast-moving, low-bureaucracy culture with real autonomy High growth opportunity as the company scales

- Analytical Rigor: Ability to A/B test agent prompts and "reasoning loops" to improve meeting-set rates.

title: Brazil Senior Condition Intelligence (Ci & Pm)
description:
Company DescriptionDingo Software is the global leader in predictive maintenance software for the mining industry, serving some of the world’s largest mining companies. We are best known for Driving efficiency, longevity and reliability for machines that matter. With 30+ years of asset health data, we're scaling rapidly under Riverside Company ownership to capture significant market opportunities.Following recent investment from The Riverside Company, Dingo is executing an ambitious growth strategy. We're building world-class commercial capabilities to support this growth journey.Role DescriptionAs a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime.In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within then Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo’s advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage client to identify risks before they escalate, ensuring consistently measurable results.With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo’s reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence.Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality.Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life.Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics.Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities.Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality.Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records.Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes.Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences.Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management.QualificationsExperience – Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments;
OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands-on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable.Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes.Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies.Technical Proficiency – Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions.Linguistic Proficiency – Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders.Communication & Leadership – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes. Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. description: As an Account Manager for Brazil, you'll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You're the perfect fit for our team if you: Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Brazilian Portuguese and English. Understand gambling products, platforms, and regulations in specific regions. Drive change and support accounts in the iGaming industry with your sales skills. Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments. Focus on exceeding sales targets and driving revenue growth. Bring experience in iGaming strategy, sales, or affiliate management. Excel in building and maintaining strong relationships with partners. Possess excellent communication and negotiation skills. Show active listening, resilience, and persistence. Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination. Excel in time management, organization, and planning. Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously. Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making. Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments. Be open to occasional travel for client meetings and industry events. What’s in it for you Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time. Flexible Schedule: We measure results, not hours, and offer paid time off. Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path. Team Gatherings: Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun. We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone. Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice. MoveUp Media
